displayName: Block users from adding eSIM profiles
description: If 'True', users cannot add eSIM profiles to the device. If 'False', Intune doesn't change or update this setting. By default, the OS allows users to add eSIM profiles. Available for fully managed, dedicated, and corporate-owned work profile devices.

options.description: The user is allowed to add eSIM profiles on the device.
The user is not allowed to add eSIM profiles on the device.
